intro.text: A Vorin kingdom of eastern Roshar, ruled by a king and ten highprinces, where reading is left to women and ardents.
The largest country on Roshar and the most prominent Vorin nation, in the east of the continent, famed for its militarism. Its royal colours are blue and gold.

description.text: Alethkar is a feudal kingdom: the king is served by ten highprinces, each with lighteyed subjects down to the citylords of single towns. Shardbearers stand slightly apart from this order.
Alethi life is split into masculine and feminine roles, from art to food. Reading and writing belong to women and ardents, so most men cannot read.
Far in the east, Alethkar is battered by heavy highstorms, so towns are built in the lee of laits, where plants also grow thickest.
Most Alethi worship the Almighty through the ardents, who are owned by lighteyes. Ardents are open to anyone, regarded as genderless, and alone may use Soulcasters.

items.text: Early on, Kholinar became the capital; it still stands, one of the oldest cities on Roshar.
Early in its history, before the Sixth Epoch, Alethkar was ruled by King Nohadon. In one Desolation in his lifetime, nine in ten of its people died.
Under the Hierocracy, the Vorin church censored and rewrote history.
After the Hierocracy fell, the church split into devotaries, and ardents lost the right to own property or hold office.
In 1140, Brightlord Yezriar was defeated and his lands folded into a growing, united Alethkar.
In 1155, Dalinar Kholin conquered the Reshi island of Akak and claimed it for Alethkar.
After Gavilar's crowning, Reshi raiders tried to exploit the instability with raids in the northern princedoms.
In 1167, Szeth assassinated King Gavilar on the Parshendi's orders. Elhokar became king, and the highprinces swore the Vengeance Pact and marched on the Shattered Plains.
During the war, Dalinar began to have visions of the past that made others doubt his sanity.
The Everstorm freed the parshmen, who fled their owners across Alethkar, and damaged or destroyed many buildings.
Led by the Fused, the singers slowly took control of Alethkar, pushing the few Alethi armies left in the country into Herdaz.
After the battle at Thaylen City, the Alethi crowned Jasnah Kholin, and a week later Adolin married Shallan Davar.
